req.title: Login sets session on success
req.statement: The system shall set session['user_id'] and redirect to / when POST /auth/login receives a matching username and password.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-008 requires that POST /auth/login with valid credentials returns HTTP 302 to '/' and sets session['user_id']. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid username+password yields 302 and session cookie with correct user_id; (2) negative NEG — wrong password yields no redirect and no session mutation; (3) negative NEG — unknown username yields no redirect; (4) BVA — session['user_id'] equals exactly the DB row id (1 for 'test'), catching constant/assignment mutations; (5) STC — after logout the session is cleared, confirming the state transition from logged-in back to anonymous. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutants.

tests.name: test_login_valid_credentials_redirects_to_index
preconditions: Database initialised with fixture user id=1 username='test' password='test'
expected: Response does not contain error text
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/', f'Expected Location /, got {r.headers["Location"]}'
assert b'Incorrect' not in r.data
os.unlink(path)

def test_login_valid_credentials_redirects_to_index():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
    assert b'Incorrect' not in r.data
    os.unlink(path)

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

def test_login_sets_session_user_id_to_exact_db_id():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess
    client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' in sess
        assert sess['user_id'] == 1
    os.unlink(path)

tests.name: test_login_session_cleared_then_set_on_success
preconditions: Database initialised with both fixture users
A prior session exists for user id=2 before login attempt
expected: session['user_id'] == 1 (old session cleared, new one set)
trace: R-FLASKR-008: session.clear() then session['user_id']=user['id'] — catches mutation that skips clear or assigns wrong id
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

def test_login_session_cleared_then_set_on_success():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        sess['user_id'] = 2
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert sess['user_id'] == 1
        assert sess['user_id'] != 2
    os.unlink(path)
